method: Independent source inspection plus existing result inspection; no duplicate campaign
accepted_scope: Finite-grid Fisher block whitening and susceptibility-ratio eigenvalue enclosure, CG versus PCG at actual natural-coordinate residual
limitations: Timings use dense assembled H matrix-vector products; matrix-free asymptotic cost theorem is not a benchmark result.
Code uses dOmega/Y while derivation uses domega/Z; both normalized bases give identical angular Gram identities.

Equal Euclidean natural-coordinate residual is a declared common stopping criterion, not automatically equal H-energy solution error; both diagnostics are recorded and theory supplies a block-computable energy error bound.
